spots.inventoryEvidence: Resource availability is inferred from the filmed terrain (tree trunks, bushes and a distinct ore actor) and the documented ARK Wiki harvesting mechanics: Trees provide Wood/Thatch and a Pick favors Thatch; Rocks provide Stone using a Hatchet; a Metal Sickle collects Fiber from plants. Water availability derives from actual visible water shoreline and Flint from visible harvestable ground rocks plus standard Metal Pick rock harvesting mechanics; no specific yield or extra GPS actor claimed.
